question: Compute the Laplace transform of x(t) = u(t) (the unit step) and state its region of convergence.

steps.description: Write the definition of the Laplace transform for x(t) = u(t)
steps.notes: Standard one-sided Laplace transform definition; lower limit 0 is correct for the unit step.

steps.description: Since u(t) = 1 for t >= 0, replace u(t) with 1 in the integral
steps.notes: u(t) = 1 for all t in [0, ∞), so substitution is valid.

steps.description: Evaluate the integral of exp(-s*t) from 0 to infinity
steps.notes: Antiderivative is exp(-st)/(-s); evaluating gives 0 - (-1/s) = 1/s, convergent for Re(s) > 0.
